title.suggested: Minister Likens Old Bare-Knuckle Fights to Football

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch quoted an Indianapolis Methodist minister who praised Kid McCoy's gloved exhibition, saying the bare-knuckle fights of McCool, Tom Allen and Morrissey were kin to college football.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, March 20, 1898, page 14.

notes: The current summary has it backwards: the minister did not favor the bare-knuckle fights; he compared them to the football he was criticizing. Allen is only named in a list.
